svg.title: Decide whether there is time for another attempt
svg.desc: Milestone 3 overview in six perspective columns: Domain, Architecture, Subsystem Design, Subsystem Interfaces, State Management and Verification. Green outlines mark new subjects, blue outlines mark changed subjects and gray outlines mark unchanged context. RetryPolicy gains time_budget; retry() reads an injectable clock and fixes a deadline at the first call. Before each wait the attempt loop asks whether now plus the full wait is before the deadline, and after the wait whether now is still before it; otherwise it raises the last exception. A retry that starts in time returns its result even after the deadline. Checks with a controlled clock cover the report being ready or not at 1.1 seconds, the equality boundary, a wait overrun and an unset budget.
svg.text: Decide whether there is time for another attempt
Baseline: milestone 2 • A time_budget limits when retries may start; it never interrupts a call that has started.
